newsitem.title: CHINA: China Merchants issues rights reminder.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants issues rights reminder.

text.p: China Merchants Shekou Port Service Holding Co Ltd said on Friday its B share holders must pay its three-for-10 rights issue by July 29.
The rights offer by the company, whose B shares have a secondary listing in Singapore, was priced at HK$4.2 per share, China Merchants said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company, which handles port facilities in Shenzhen, has said it would use net proceeds of HK$160.5 million expected from the cash call to expand core operations.
The firm posted net profits of 95.66 million yuan for 1996 against 120.98 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
The company has said it would issue its distributable profits of 41.64 million yuan for 1996 after it completed the rights issue. It did not give a dividend proposal.
